Simon Fairbrother had eased his way through to join club-mate Haywood and with another man in 11th the Boxhill Billies were having another strong team run - but, fingers crossed, had to go back too far for their 5th and 6th men.

Clive's run gave us our highest placing throughout the race but also put an unfit Graham Adams, just off the plane from holidaying in the USA, in the unenviable position of setting out with Boxhill's Simon Fairbrother on his tail.
